title: 第1012章 拯救玄灵界心境突破第1011章 顺利脱困再回西北境
content_zh:
阵法陡然亮起，将整个飞升通道笼罩起来。
楚峰脸色一变，顿时认了出来，这阵法竟然是八级高等阵法，道台境巅峰的强者，短时间内都无法破开。
阵法有部分延伸到了飞升通道之中，只要感应到了元神力量便会发动。
他的元神力探入飞升通道后，便将其触发了。
但好在这阵法乃是为了封住从玄灵界飞升上来的人，而他则是要进入玄灵界中，只是将他困在了飞升通道附近，短时间内无法离开而已。
“没想到那刘安竟然还有这么一手，这是不打算让玄灵界的人飞升上来吗？”
楚峰双眼一眯。
刘安这是要彻底断绝玄灵界武者的武道之路啊。
此刻，那位隐藏在暗处的守卫立刻取出一枚玉符，迅速传信给靖西王刘安。
楚峰没有犹豫，直接跳进了飞升通道，同时传音给庞烈：
“老庞，我已经进来了，先拉我回玄灵界！”
飞升通道深处，一股强大的力量涌出，将楚峰包裹着朝着飞升通道下方极速坠落而去。
也幸好楚峰的修为没有突破元神境。
不然必定会遭受法则之力的阻碍。
因为隐身术的缘故，暗中隐藏的守卫只感知到阵法被触发了，却根本没看到有人来过，只是认为有人正在飞升通道里，正准备飞升上来。
几息之后，靖安城的城主带着一队人马匆匆赶到。
此人道台境修为，满脸横肉，眼神凌厉。
他围着阵法转了三圈，等了足足半个时辰，却连个人影都没见着。
“怎么回事？”
城主皱眉问道。

那守卫连忙躬身：
“大人，阵法确实被触发了，卑职一直守在这里，但并未看到有人从里面出来……”
城主正要开口，飞升通道里忽然传来一声粗犷的大骂声：
“哈哈哈，刘安的走狗们，别等了！
你爷爷我今天心情烦，故意碰一下你们的破阵，消耗一下你们的灵石。
我告诉你们，从今天开始，我隔三差五就碰一下，你们就等着天天换灵石吧！
这就是你们针对我玄灵界武者的代价！”
城主脸色铁青。
这阵法的确耗费灵石，每时每刻都在消耗这灵石，而且还是上品灵石。
要是真被这混蛋一天碰几回，靖安城的库房都得掏空。
“混账！”
城主咬牙切齿，却又毫无办法。
打又打不进去，骂又骂不过。
僵持了大半天，他只能一挥手：
content_en:
The formation suddenly lit up, covering the entire ascension channel.
Chu Feng's expression changed, and he immediately recognized it. This formation turned out to be an eighth-level advanced formation. A strong person at the peak of the Taoist realm would not be able to break through it in a short period of time.
Part of the formation extends into the ascension channel, and will be activated as long as the power of the soul is sensed.
After his soul power penetrated into the ascension channel, he triggered it.
But fortunately, this formation was designed to seal the person who ascended from the Xuanling Realm, and he wanted to enter the Xuanling Realm, but it just trapped him near the ascension passage and could not leave in a short time.
"I didn't expect Liu An to have such a skill. Doesn't he intend to let people from the Xuanling Realm ascend?"
Chu Feng narrowed his eyes.
Liu An wants to completely cut off the martial arts path of Xuanling Realm warriors.
At this moment, the guard hiding in the dark immediately took out a jade talisman and quickly sent a message to Jingxi King Liu An.
Chu Feng did not hesitate and jumped directly into the ascension channel. At the same time, he sent a message to Pang Lie:
"Old Pang, I have already come in, please take me back to the Xuanling Realm first!"
Deep in the ascension channel, a powerful force surged out, wrapping Chu Feng and falling rapidly towards the bottom of the ascension channel.
Fortunately, Chu Feng's cultivation level did not break through to the Yuanshen realm.
Otherwise, you will definitely be hindered by the power of the law.
Because of the invisibility technique, the hidden guards only sensed that the formation was triggered, but did not see anyone coming at all. They just thought that someone was in the ascension channel and was about to ascend.
A few breaths later, the city lord of Jingan City hurriedly arrived with a team of troops.
This person is at the Dao Stage level, with a fleshy face and sharp eyes.
He circled around the formation three times and waited for half an hour, but he didn't even see a single figure.
"What's going on?"
The city lord asked with a frown.
The guard quickly bowed:
"Sir, the formation has indeed been triggered. I have been guarding here, but I didn't see anyone coming out..."
Just as the city lord was about to speak, a rough curse suddenly came from the ascension passage:
"Hahaha, Liu An's lackeys, don't wait any longer!
Your grandpa and I are in a bad mood today, so I deliberately touched your broken formation to consume your spiritual stones.
Let me tell you, starting from today, I will touch it every now and then, and you just wait to change the spirit stone every day!
This is the price you pay for targeting me, the warrior of the Xuanling Realm! "
The city lord's face was ashen.
This formation does consume spiritual stones, which are consumed every moment, and it is also a high-grade spiritual stone.
If you are really touched by this bastard several times a day, the warehouses in Jingan City will be empty.
"Asshole!"
The city lord gritted his teeth, but there was nothing he could do.
He couldn't get in despite beating him, and he couldn't get in after scolding him.
After a stalemate for most of the day, he could only wave his hand:
